top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Elevated Oil Deepens Bond Selloff: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks fell as elevated oil prices added to pressure on Treasuries, pushing the 10-year yield to levels last seen 19 years ago and keeping risk appetite firmly in check.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Singapore’s Air Quality Reaches Worst Since 2019
top_signals.summary:
Singapore is shrouded in haze, with smoke from wildfires in neighboring Indonesia raising islandwide pollution to levels that pose a health risk.

Gabrielle Ng has more.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: White House crypto adviser feels ‘very good’ ahead of Senate Clarity Act vote on Tuesday
top_signals.summary: The White House's top crypto advisor says he feels "very good" about an initial vote in the Senate on cryptocurrency legislation on Tuesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
